zh: 新增侧栏悬停展开：侧栏收起时，鼠标停在侧栏按钮上，侧栏就浮在页面上方展开，主窗口宽度不变；鼠标移开或选中会话后自动收起，点击按钮仍是固定展开，可在设置页「侧栏 → 悬停展开侧栏」关闭；Windows 桌面端与 web 生效（#108）。
en: Add opening the sidebar on hover: while the sidebar is collapsed, resting the pointer on its toggle opens it over the page and the main window keeps its width; it closes when the pointer leaves or a session is picked, a click on the toggle still keeps it open, and Settings → Sidebar → Open the sidebar on hover turns it off; it works on the Windows desktop app and the web (#108).
